    Modules with minimal endomorphism ring are rigid #

    ExtVanish X Y says that every short exact sequence 0 → Y → E → X → 0 splits. It passes to direct sums in both variables (extVanish_fst, extVanish_snd). If every nonzero indecomposable module is rigid, then a module V whose endomorphism ring has minimal dimension among modules with the same value of an additive invariant (such as the dimension vector) is rigid (extVanish_of_minEnd; ASS IX.3.3, proof): a nonsplit extension between a summand and its complement would have a smaller endomorphism ring (ASS VIII.2.8, finrank_end_lt).
